title: Synthesis, characterization, and photocatalytic study of Bi-doped CuS nanoparticles

Pure CuS and Bi-doped CuS nanoparticles (NPs) with varying concentrations (2.5, 5, 7.5, and 10 wt%) of Bi were synthesized using a facile chemical co-precipitation method.
